callbacks.name: SceneResource_SetTransitionTileBandReady
callbacks.body: Saves A0, loads ROM source 0x00129B72, calls Render_UploadPaletteBand2, stores 0xFF in SCENE_TRANSITION_TILE_BAND_READY at 0x00FFF102, restores A0, and returns.
callbacks.effect: Publishes the transition palette band 2 and arms the scene-transition tile-band service latch.

callbacks.name: SceneResource_ClearTransitionTileBandReady
callbacks.body: Saves A0, loads ROM source 0x00128ED2 and calls Render_UploadPaletteBand0, loads ROM source 0x00129B52 and calls Render_UploadPaletteBand2, clears SCENE_TRANSITION_TILE_BAND_READY at 0x00FFF102, restores A0, and returns.
callbacks.effect: Restores the blank transition palette bands and disarms the scene-transition tile-band service latch.

relationships.movement_stream: ACTOR_MOVE_TRANSITION_PRESENTATION_LEAD_IN at 0x00120360 pushes 0x001B1640 and 0x001B1656 as callback parameters.
relationships.latch_consumer: SceneResource_InitializeTransitionPresentation clears 0x00FFF102 before its initial service pass and calls SceneResource_RenderTransitionTileBand when the latch is nonzero.

limitations: The callbacks are invoked through the VM's deferred callback convention; no direct 68000 call edge is emitted for the pushed addresses.
The exact higher-level presentation phase represented by the latch remains named from its static producer/consumer contract rather than a runtime trace.
